newsitem.title: TAIWAN: TAIWAN SEMICON IN T$5 BLN RATE OPERATION ABROAD.
newsitem.headline: TAIWAN SEMICON IN T$5 BLN RATE OPERATION ABROAD.

text.p: Microchip giant Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co said on Tuesday it plans to commission two international fund management firms to run T$5 billion for it in overseas interest rate products.

"To have a more aggressive financial operation, we plan to commission two international fund management firms to run for us T$5 billion in interest rate products overseas," public relations manager Tseng Ching-hao told Reuters.
The funds will invest in interest rate-related products such as U.S. government bonds, Eurodollar bonds and bills, he said.
Tseng declined to reveal the names of the two fund managers.
The company hoped to add an annual profit return of more than two percent to its normal gains with the move, Tseng said.
Taiwan Semiconductor always holds around T$10 billion in cash, he said.
